289 Batch inference 290 291 ```python 292 # for batch generation, padding_side should be set to left! 293 processor.tokenizer.padding_side = 'left' 294 295 # Sample messages for batch inference 296 messages1 = [ 297 { 298 "role": "user", 299 "content": [ 300 {"type": "image", "image": "file:///path/to/image1.jpg"}, 301 {"type": "image", "image": "file:///path/to/image2.jpg"}, 302 {"type": "text", "text": "What are the common elements in these pictures?"}, 303 ], 304 } 305 ] 306 messages2 = [ 307 {"role": "system", "content": [{"type": "text", "text": "You are a helpful assistant."}]}, 308 {"role": "user", "content": [{"type": "text", "text": "Who are you?"}]}, 309 ] 310 # Combine messages for batch processing 311 messages = [messages1, messages2] 312 313 # Preparation for inference 314 inputs = processor.apply_chat_template( 315 messages, 316 tokenize=True, 317 add_generation_prompt=True, 318 return_dict=True, 319 return_tensors="pt", 320 padding=True # padding should be set for batch generation! 321 ) 322 inputs = inputs.to(model.device) 323 324 # Inference: Generation of the output 325 generated_ids = model.generate(**inputs, max_new_tokens=128) 326 generated_ids_trimmed = [ 327 out_ids[len(in_ids) :] for in_ids, out_ids in zip(inputs.input_ids, generated_ids) 328 ] 329 output_text = processor.batch_decode( 330 generated_ids_trimmed, skip_special_tokens=True, clean_up_tokenization_spaces=False 331 ) 332 print(output_text) 333 ``` 334
335 336
337 Pixel Control via Official Processor 338 339 Using the official HF processor, we can conveniently control the budget of visual tokens. Since the Qwen3-VL processor separates image and video processing, we can independently configure the pixel budget for each modality. 340 - **For the image processor**: 341 The parameter `size['longest_edge']` originally corresponds to `max_pixels`, which defines the maximum number of pixels allowed for an image (i.e., for an image of height H and width W, H × W must not exceed `max_pixels`; image channels are ignored for simplicity). 342 Similarly, `size['shortest_edge']` corresponds to `min_pixels`, specifying the minimum allowable pixel count for an image. 343 344 - **For the video processor**: 345 The interpretation differs slightly. `size['longest_edge']` represents the maximum total number of pixels across all frames in a video — for a video of shape T×H×W, the product T×H×W must not exceed `size['longest_edge']`. 346 Similarly, `size['shortest_edge']` sets the minimum total pixel budget for the video. 347 348 ```python 349 processor = AutoProcessor.from_pretrained("Qwen/Qwen3-VL-235B-A22B-Instruct") 350 351 # budget for image processor, since the compression ratio is 32 for Qwen3-VL, we can set the number of visual tokens of a single image to 256-1280 (32× spatial compression) 352 processor.image_processor.size = {"longest_edge": 1280*32*32, "shortest_edge": 256*32*32} 353 354 # budget for video processor, we can set the number of visual tokens of a single video to 256-16384 (32× spatial compression + 2× temporal compression) 355 processor.video_processor.size = {"longest_edge": 16384*32*32*2, "shortest_edge": 256*32*32*2} 356 ``` 357 358 - You can further control the **sample fps** or **sample frames** of video, as shown below. 359 360 ```python 361 messages = [ 362 { 363 "role": "user", 364 "content": [ 365 { 366 "type": "video", 367 "video": "https://qianwen-res.oss-cn-beijing.aliyuncs.com/Qwen2-VL/space_woaudio.mp4", 368 }, 369 {"type": "text", "text": "Describe this video."}, 370 ], 371 } 372 ] 373 374 # for video input, we can further control the fps or num_frames. \ 375 # defaultly, fps is set to 2 376 377 # set fps = 4 378 inputs = processor.apply_chat_template( 379 messages, 380 tokenize=True, 381 add_generation_prompt=True, 382 return_dict=True, 383 return_tensors="pt", 384 fps=4 385 ) 386 inputs = inputs.to(model.device) 387 388 # set num_frames = 128 and overwrite the fps to None! 389 # inputs = processor.apply_chat_template( 390 # messages, 391 # tokenize=True, 392 # add_generation_prompt=True, 393 # return_dict=True, 394 # return_tensors="pt", 395 # num_frames=128, 396 # fps=None, 397 # ) 398 # inputs = inputs.to(model.device) 399 400 # Inference: Generation of the output 401 generated_ids = model.generate(**inputs, max_new_tokens=128) 402 generated_ids_trimmed = [ 403 out_ids[len(in_ids) :] for in_ids, out_ids in zip(inputs.input_ids, generated_ids) 404 ] 405 output_text = processor.batch_decode( 406 generated_ids_trimmed, skip_special_tokens=True, clean_up_tokenization_spaces=False 407 ) 408 print(output_text) 409 ``` 410
411 412 ### New `qwen-vl-utils` Usage 413 414 With the latest `qwen-vl-utils` toolkit (backward compatible with Qwen2.5-VL), you can control pixel constraints per visual input. 415 416 ```bash 417 pip install qwen-vl-utils==0.0.14 418 # It's highly recommended to use `[decord]` feature for faster video loading. 419 # pip install qwen-vl-utils[decord] 420 ``` 421 422 Compared to previous version, the new `qwen-vl-utils` introduces: 423 424 - "image_patch_size": `14` for Qwen2.5-VL and `16` for Qwen3-VL. Default set to `14`. 425 426 - "return_video_metadata"(Qwen3-VL only): Due to the new video processor, if True, each video returns as (video_tensor, video_metadata). Default set to `False`. 427 428 ```python 429 # for Qwen2.5VL, you can simply call 430 images, videos, video_kwargs = process_vision_info(messages, return_video_kwargs=True) 431 432 # For Qwen3VL series, you should call 433 images, videos, video_kwargs = process_vision_info(messages, image_patch_size=16, return_video_kwargs=True, return_video_metadata=True) 434 ``` 435 436 📌 Note: Since `qwen-vl-utils` already resizes images/videos, pass `do_resize=False` to the processor to avoid duplicate resizing. 437 438
439 Process Images 440 441 For input images, we support local files, base64, and URLs. 442 443 ```python 444 # You can directly insert a local file path, a URL, or a base64-encoded image into the position where you want in the text. 445 ## Local file path 446 messages = [ 447 { 448 "role": "user", 449 "content": [ 450 {"type": "image", "image": "file:///path/to/your/image.jpg"}, 451 {"type": "text", "text": "Describe this image."}, 452 ], 453 } 454 ] 455 ## Image URL 456 messages = [ 457 { 458 "role": "user", 459 "content": [ 460 {"type": "image", "image": "http://path/to/your/image.jpg"}, 461 {"type": "text", "text": "Describe this image."}, 462 ], 463 } 464 ] 465 ## Base64 encoded image 466 messages = [ 467 { 468 "role": "user", 469 "content": [ 470 {"type": "image", "image": "data:image;base64,/9j/..."}, 471 {"type": "text", "text": "Describe this image."}, 472 ], 473 } 474 ] 475 ``` 476 477 We provide two methods for fine-grained control over the image size input to the model: 478 479 - Specify exact dimensions: Directly set resized_height and resized_width. These values will be rounded to the nearest multiple of 32 (32 for Qwen3VL, 28 for Qwen2.5VL). 480 481 - Define min_pixels and max_pixels: Images will be resized to maintain their aspect ratio within the range of min_pixels and max_pixels 482 483 ```python 484 from transformers import AutoModelForImageTextToText, AutoProcessor 485 from qwen_vl_utils import process_vision_info 486 487 model = AutoModelForImageTextToText.from_pretrained( 488 "Qwen/Qwen3-VL-235B-A22B-Instruct", dtype="auto", device_map="auto" 489 ) 490 491 processor = AutoProcessor.from_pretrained("Qwen/Qwen3-VL-235B-A22B-Instruct") 492 493 # resized_height and resized_width 494 messages = [ 495 { 496 "role": "user", 497 "content": [ 498 { 499 "type": "image", 500 "image": "https://qianwen-res.oss-cn-beijing.aliyuncs.com/Qwen-VL/assets/demo.jpeg", 501 "resized_height": 280, 502 "resized_width": 420, 503 }, 504 {"type": "text", "text": "Describe this image."}, 505 ], 506 } 507 ] 508 509 # min_pixels and max_pixels 510 messages = [ 511 { 512 "role": "user", 513 "content": [ 514 { 515 "type": "image", 516 "image": "https://qianwen-res.oss-cn-beijing.aliyuncs.com/Qwen-VL/assets/demo.jpeg", 517 "min_pixels": 50176, 518 "max_pixels": 50176, 519 520 }, 521 {"type": "text", "text": "Describe this image."}, 522 ], 523 } 524 ] 525 526 # Preparation for inference with qwen-vl-utils 527 text = processor.apply_chat_template(messages, tokenize=False, add_generation_prompt=True) 528 images, videos = process_vision_info(messages, image_patch_size=16) 529 530 # since qwen-vl-utils has resize the images/videos, \ 531 # we should pass do_resize=False to avoid duplicate operation in processor! 532 inputs = processor(text=text, images=images, videos=videos, do_resize=False, return_tensors="pt") 533 inputs = inputs.to(model.device) 534 535 # Inference: Generation of the output 536 generated_ids = model.generate(**inputs, max_new_tokens=128) 537 generated_ids_trimmed = [ 538 out_ids[len(in_ids) :] for in_ids, out_ids in zip(inputs.input_ids, generated_ids) 539 ] 540 output_text = processor.batch_decode( 541 generated_ids_trimmed, skip_special_tokens=True, clean_up_tokenization_spaces=False 542 ) 543 print(output_text) 544 ``` 545 546

549 Process Videos 550 551 For input videos, we support images lists, local path and url. 552 553 ```python 554 # Messages containing a images list as a video and a text query 555 messages = [ 556 { 557 "role": "user", 558 "content": [ 559 { 560 "type": "video", 561 "video": [ 562 "file:///path/to/frame1.jpg", 563 "file:///path/to/frame2.jpg", 564 "file:///path/to/frame3.jpg", 565 "file:///path/to/frame4.jpg", 566 ], 567 'sample_fps':'1', # sample_fps: frame sampling rate (frames per second), used to determine timestamps for each frame 568 }, 569 {"type": "text", "text": "Describe this video."}, 570 ], 571 } 572 ] 573 574 # Messages containing a local video path and a text query 575 messages = [ 576 { 577 "role": "user", 578 "content": [ 579 { 580 "type": "video", 581 "video": "file:///path/to/video1.mp4", 582 "max_pixels": 360 * 420, 583 "fps": 1.0, 584 }, 585 {"type": "text", "text": "Describe this video."}, 586 ], 587 } 588 ] 589 590 # Messages containing a video url and a text query 591 messages = [ 592 { 593 "role": "user", 594 "content": [ 595 { 596 "type": "video", 597 "video": "https://qianwen-res.oss-cn-beijing.aliyuncs.com/Qwen2-VL/space_woaudio.mp4", 598 "min_pixels": 4 * 32 * 32, 599 "max_pixels": 256 * 32 * 32, 600 "total_pixels": 20480 * 32 * 32, 601 }, 602 {"type": "text", "text": "Describe this video."}, 603 ], 604 } 605 ] 606 607 ``` 608 609 We recommend setting appropriate values for the `min_pixels` and `max_pixels` parameters based on available GPU memory and the specific application scenario to restrict the resolution of individual frames in the video. 610 611 Alternatively, you can use the `total_pixels` parameter to limit the total number of tokens in the video (it is recommended to set this value below 24576 * 32 * 32 to avoid excessively long input sequences). For more details on parameter usage and processing logic, please refer to the `fetch_video` function in `qwen_vl_utils/vision_process.py`. 612 613 ```python 614 from transformers import AutoModelForImageTextToText, AutoProcessor 615 from qwen_vl_utils import process_vision_info 616 617 model = AutoModelForImageTextToText.from_pretrained( 618 "Qwen/Qwen3-VL-235B-A22B-Instruct", dtype="auto", device_map="auto" 619 ) 620 621 processor = AutoProcessor.from_pretrained("Qwen/Qwen3-VL-235B-A22B-Instruct") 622 623 messages = [ 624 { 625 "role": "user", 626 "content": [ 627 { 628 "type": "video", 629 "video": "https://qianwen-res.oss-cn-beijing.aliyuncs.com/Qwen2-VL/space_woaudio.mp4", 630 "min_pixels": 4 * 32 * 32, 631 "max_pixels": 256 * 32 * 32, 632 "total_pixels": 20480 * 32 * 32, 633 }, 634 {"type": "text", "text": "Describe this video."}, 635 ], 636 } 637 ] 638 639 text = processor.apply_chat_template(messages, tokenize=False, add_generation_prompt=True) 640 images, videos, video_kwargs = process_vision_info(messages, image_patch_size=16, return_video_kwargs=True, return_video_metadata=True) 641 642 # split the videos and according metadatas 643 if videos is not None: 644 videos, video_metadatas = zip(*videos) 645 videos, video_metadatas = list(videos), list(video_metadatas) 646 else: 647 video_metadatas = None 648 649 # since qwen-vl-utils has resize the images/videos, \ 650 # we should pass do_resize=False to avoid duplicate operation in processor! 651 inputs = processor(text=text, images=images, videos=videos, video_metadata=video_metadatas, return_tensors="pt", do_resize=False, **video_kwargs) 652 inputs = inputs.to(model.device) 653 654 # Inference: Generation of the output 655 generated_ids = model.generate(**inputs, max_new_tokens=128) 656 generated_ids_trimmed = [ 657 out_ids[len(in_ids) :] for in_ids, out_ids in zip(inputs.input_ids, generated_ids) 658 ] 659 output_text = processor.batch_decode( 660 generated_ids_trimmed, skip_special_tokens=True, clean_up_tokenization_spaces=False 661 ) 662 print(output_text) 663 ``` 664 665

668 Video Backends and URL Compatibility 669 670 Currently, `qwen-vl-utils` supports three video decoding backends: `torchvision`, `decord`, and `torchcodec`. While `decord` and `torchcodec` generally offer significantly faster decoding speeds compared to `torchvision`, we recommend using `torchcodec`. This is because `decord` has known issues, such as decoding hangs, and its project is no longer actively maintained. 671 672 - For `decord`, if you are not using Linux, you might not be able to install `decord` from PyPI. In that case, you can use `pip install qwen-vl-utils` which will fall back to using torchvision for video processing. However, you can still [install decord from source](https://github.com/dmlc/decord?tab=readme-ov-file#install-from-source) to get decord used when loading video. 673 674 - To use `torchcodec` as the backend for video decoding, follow the installation instructions provided in the official [torchcodec repository](https://github.com/pytorch/torchcodec/tree/main?tab=readme-ov-file#installing-torchcodec) and install it manually. Note that `torchcodec` depends on FFmpeg for decoding functionality. 675 676 Video URL compatibility is primarily determined by the version of the third-party library being used. For more details, refer to the table below. If you prefer not to use the default backend, you can switch it by setting `FORCE_QWENVL_VIDEO_READER` to `torchvision`, `decord`, or `torchcodec`. 677 678 | Backend | HTTP | HTTPS | 679 |-------------|------|-------| 680 | torchvision >= 0.19.0 | ✅ | ✅ | 681 | torchvision < 0.19.0 | ❌ | ❌ | 682 | decord | ✅ | ❌ | 683 | torchcodec | ✅ | ✅ | 684 685

739 740 #### Flash-Attention 2 to speed up generation 741 742 First, make sure to install the latest version of Flash Attention 2: 743 744 ```bash 745 pip install -U flash-attn --no-build-isolation 746 ``` 747 748 Also, you should have a hardware that is compatible with Flash-Attention 2. Read more about it in the official documentation of the [flash attention repository](https://github.com/Dao-AILab/flash-attention). FlashAttention-2 can only be used when a model is loaded in `torch.float16` or `torch.bfloat16`. 749 750 To load and run a model using Flash Attention-2, simply add `attn_implementation="flash_attention_2"` when loading the model as follows: 751 752 ```python 753 import torch 754 from transformers import AutoModelForImageTextToText 755 756 model = AutoModelForImageTextToText.from_pretrained( 757 "Qwen/Qwen3-VL-235B-A22B-Instruct", 758 torch_dtype=torch.bfloat16, 759 attn_implementation="flash_attention_2", 760 ) 761 ``` 762 763 #### Processing Long Texts 764 765 The current `config.json` is set for context length up to 256K tokens. 766 To handle extensive inputs exceeding 256K tokens, we utilize [YaRN](https://arxiv.org/abs/2309.00071), a technique for enhancing model length extrapolation, ensuring optimal performance on lengthy texts. 767 768 For supported frameworks (currently transformers and vLLM), you could modify `max_position_embeddings` and `rope_scaling` in `config.json` to enable YaRN: 769 770 ``` 771 { 772 "max_position_embeddings": 1000000, 773 ..., 774 "rope_scaling": { 775 "rope_type": "yarn", 776 "mrope_section": [ 777 24, 778 20, 779 20 780 ], 781 "mrope_interleaved": true, 782 "factor": 3.0, 783 "original_max_position_embeddings": 262144 784 }, 785 ... 786 } 787 ``` 788 789 When using vLLM for serving, you can also enable YaRN by adding the additional arguments `--rope-scaling` and `--max-model-len`. 790 791 ``` 792 vllm serve Qwen/Qwen3-VL-235B-A22B-Instruct --rope-scaling '{"rope_type":"yarn","factor":3.0,"original_max_position_embeddings": 262144,"mrope_section":[24,20,20],"mrope_interleaved": true}' --max-model-len 1000000 793 ``` 794 795 > Because Interleaved-MRoPE’s position IDs grow more slowly than vanilla RoPE, use a **smaller scaling factor**. For example, to support 1M context with 256K context length, set factor=2 or 3 — not 4. 796 797 ### Try Qwen3-VL-235B-A22 with API! 798 799 To explore Qwen3-VL-235B-A22, a more fascinating multimodal model, we encourage you to test our cutting-edge API service. # Qwen3-VL

💜 Qwen Chat   |   🤗 Hugging Face   |   🤖 ModelScope   |   📑 Blog   |   📚 Cookbooks   |   📑 Paper  
🖥️ Demo   |   💬 WeChat (微信)   |   🫨 Discord   |   📑 API   |   🖥️ PAI-DSW

## Introduction Meet Qwen3-VL — the most powerful vision-language model in the Qwen series to date. This generation delivers comprehensive upgrades across the board: superior text understanding & generation, deeper visual perception & reasoning, extended context length, enhanced spatial and video dynamics comprehension, and stronger agent interaction capabilities. Available in Dense and MoE architectures that scale from edge to cloud, with Instruct and reasoning‑enhanced Thinking editions for flexible, on‑demand deployment. #### Key Enhancements: * **Visual Agent**: Operates PC/mobile GUIs—recognizes elements, understands functions, invokes tools, completes tasks. * **Visual Coding Boost**: Generates Draw.io/HTML/CSS/JS from images/videos. * **Advanced Spatial Perception**: Judges object positions, viewpoints, and occlusions; provides stronger 2D grounding and enables 3D grounding for spatial reasoning and embodied AI. * **Long Context & Video Understanding**: Native 256K context, expandable to 1M; handles books and hours-long video with full recall and second-level indexing. * **Enhanced Multimodal Reasoning**: Excels in STEM/Math—causal analysis and logical, evidence-based answers. * **Upgraded Visual Recognition**: Broader, higher-quality pretraining is able to “recognize everything”—celebrities, anime, products, landmarks, flora/fauna, etc. * **Expanded OCR**: Supports 32 languages (up from 10); robust in low light, blur, and tilt; better with rare/ancient characters and jargon; improved long-document structure parsing. * **Text Understanding on par with pure LLMs**: Seamless text–vision fusion for lossless, unified comprehension. #### Model Architecture Updates:

1. **Interleaved-MRoPE**: Full‑frequency allocation over time, width, and height via robust positional embeddings, enhancing long‑horizon video reasoning. 2. **DeepStack**: Fuses multi‑level ViT features to capture fine‑grained details and sharpen image–text alignment. 3. **Text–Timestamp Alignment:** Moves beyond T‑RoPE to precise, timestamp‑grounded event localization for stronger video temporal modeling. ## News * 2025.11.27: We have released the [**Qwen3-VL paper**](https://arxiv.org/pdf/2511.21631), which introduces many technical details about Qwen3-VL, and we hope it will be helpful to everyone. * 2025.10.21: We have released the **Qwen3-VL-2B** ([Instruct](https://huggingface.co/Qwen/Qwen3-VL-2B-Instruct)/[Thinking](https://huggingface.co/Qwen/Qwen3-VL-2B-Thinking)) and **Qwen3-VL-32B** ([Instruct](https://huggingface.co/Qwen/Qwen3-VL-32B-Instruct)/[Thinking](https://huggingface.co/Qwen/Qwen3-VL-32B-Thinking)). Enjoy it! * 2025.10.15: We have released the **Qwen3-VL-4B** ([Instruct](https://huggingface.co/Qwen/Qwen3-VL-4B-Instruct)/[Thinking](https://huggingface.co/Qwen/Qwen3-VL-4B-Thinking)) and **Qwen3-VL-8B** ([Instruct](https://huggingface.co/Qwen/Qwen3-VL-8B-Instruct)/[Thinking](https://huggingface.co/Qwen/Qwen3-VL-8B-Thinking)). Enjoy it! * 2025.10.4: We have released the [Qwen3-VL-30B-A3B-Instruct](https://huggingface.co/Qwen/Qwen3-VL-30B-A3B-Instruct) and [Qwen3-VL-30B-A3B-Thinking](https://huggingface.co/Qwen/Qwen3-VL-30B-A3B-Thinking). We have also released the FP8 version of the Qwen3-VL models — available in our [HuggingFace collection](https://huggingface.co/collections/Qwen/qwen3-vl-68d2a7c1b8a8afce4ebd2dbe) and [ModelScope collection](https://modelscope.cn/collections/Qwen3-VL-5c7a94c8cb144b). * 2025.09.23: We have released the [Qwen3-VL-235B-A22B-Instruct](https://huggingface.co/Qwen/Qwen3-VL-235B-A22B-Instruct) and [Qwen3-VL-235B-A22B-Thinking](https://huggingface.co/Qwen/Qwen3-VL-235B-A22B-Thinking). For more details, please check our [blog](https://qwen.ai/blog?id=99f0335c4ad9ff6153e517418d48535ab6d8afef&from=research.latest-advancements-list)! * 2025.04.08: We provide the [code](https://github.com/QwenLM/Qwen2.5-VL/tree/main/qwen-vl-finetune) for fine-tuning Qwen2-VL and Qwen2.5-VL. * 2025.03.25: We have released the [Qwen2.5-VL-32B](https://huggingface.co/Qwen/Qwen2.5-VL-32B-Instruct). It is smarter and its responses align more closely with human preferences. For more details, please check our [blog](https://qwenlm.github.io/blog/qwen2.5-vl-32b/)! * 2025.02.20: we have released the [Qwen2.5-VL Technical Report](https://arxiv.org/abs/2502.13923). Alongside the report, we have also released AWQ-quantized models for Qwen2.5-VL in three different sizes: [3B](https://huggingface.co/Qwen/Qwen2.5-VL-3B-Instruct-AWQ), [7B](https://huggingface.co/Qwen/Qwen2.5-VL-7B-Instruct-AWQ) , and [72B](https://huggingface.co/Qwen/Qwen2.5-VL-72B-Instruct-AWQ) parameters. * 2025.01.28: We have released the [Qwen2.5-VL series](https://huggingface.co/Qwen). For more details, please check our [blog](https://qwenlm.github.io/blog/qwen2.5-vl/)! * 2024.12.25: We have released the [QvQ-72B-Preview](https://huggingface.co/Qwen/QVQ-72B-Preview). QvQ-72B-Preview is an experimental research model, focusing on enhancing visual reasoning capabilities. For more details, please check our [blog](https://qwenlm.github.io/blog/qvq-72b-preview/)! * 2024.09.19: The instruction-tuned [Qwen2-VL-72B model](https://huggingface.co/Qwen/Qwen2-VL-72B-Instruct) and its quantized version [[AWQ](https://huggingface.co/Qwen/Qwen2-VL-72B-Instruct-AWQ), [GPTQ-Int4](https://huggingface.co/Qwen/Qwen2-VL-72B-Instruct-GPTQ-Int4), [GPTQ-Int8](https://huggingface.co/Qwen/Qwen2-VL-72B-Instruct-GPTQ-Int8)] are now available. We have also released the [Qwen2-VL paper](https://arxiv.org/pdf/2409.12191) simultaneously. * 2024.08.30: We have released the [Qwen2-VL series](https://huggingface.co/collections/Qwen/qwen2-vl-66cee7455501d7126940800d). The 2B and 7B models are now available, and the 72B model for open source is coming soon. For more details, please check our [blog](https://qwenlm.github.io/blog/qwen2-vl/)! ## Performance ### Visual Tasks

provide simple examples to show how to use Qwen3-VL with 🤖 ModelScope and 🤗 Transformers. ``` # The Qwen3-VL model requires transformers >= 4.57.0 pip install "transformers>=4.57.0" ``` ### 🤖 ModelScope We strongly advise users especially those in mainland China to use ModelScope. `snapshot_download` can help you solve issues concerning downloading checkpoints. ### Using 🤗 Transformers to Chat Here we show a code snippet to show you how to use the chat model with `transformers`: ```python from transformers import AutoModelForImageTextToText, AutoProcessor # default: Load the model on the available device(s) model = AutoModelForImageTextToText.from_pretrained( "Qwen/Qwen3-VL-235B-A22B-Instruct", dtype="auto", device_map="auto" ) # We recommend enabling flash_attention_2 for better acceleration and memory saving, especially in multi-image and video scenarios. # model = AutoModelForImageTextToText.from_pretrained( # "Qwen/Qwen3-VL-235B-A22B-Instruct", # dtype=torch.bfloat16, # attn_implementation="flash_attention_2", # device_map="auto", # ) processor = AutoProcessor.from_pretrained("Qwen/Qwen3-VL-235B-A22B-Instruct") messages = [ { "role": "user", "content": [ { "type": "image", "image": "https://qianwen-res.oss-cn-beijing.aliyuncs.com/Qwen-VL/assets/demo.jpeg", }, {"type": "text", "text": "Describe this image."}, ], } ] # Preparation for inference inputs = processor.apply_chat_template( messages, tokenize=True, add_generation_prompt=True, return_dict=True, return_tensors="pt" ) inputs = inputs.to(model.device) # Inference: Generation of the output generated_ids = model.generate(**inputs, max_new_tokens=128) generated_ids_trimmed = [ out_ids[len(in_ids) :] for in_ids, out_ids in zip(inputs.input_ids, generated_ids) ] output_text = processor.batch_decode( generated_ids_trimmed, skip_special_tokens=True, clean_up_tokenization_spaces=False ) print(output_text) ```
Multi image inference ```python # Messages containing multiple images and a text query messages = [ { "role": "user", "content": [ {"type": "image", "image": "file:///path/to/image1.jpg"}, {"type": "image", "image": "file:///path/to/image2.jpg"}, {"type": "text", "text": "Identify the similarities between these images."}, ], } ] # Preparation for inference inputs = processor.apply_chat_template( messages, tokenize=True, add_generation_prompt=True, return_dict=True, return_tensors="pt" ) inputs = inputs.to(model.device) # Inference: Generation of the output generated_ids = model.generate(**inputs, max_new_tokens=128) generated_ids_trimmed = [ out_ids[len(in_ids) :] for in_ids, out_ids in zip(inputs.input_ids, generated_ids) ] output_text = processor.batch_decode( generated_ids_trimmed, skip_special_tokens=True, clean_up_tokenization_spaces=False ) print(output_text) ```
Video inference ```python # Messages containing a video url(or a local path) and a text query messages = [ { "role": "user", "content": [ { "type": "video", "video": "https://qianwen-res.oss-cn-beijing.aliyuncs.com/Qwen2-VL/space_woaudio.mp4", }, {"type": "text", "text": "Describe this video."}, ], } ] # Preparation for inference inputs = processor.apply_chat_template( messages, tokenize=True, add_generation_prompt=True, return_dict=True, return_tensors="pt" ) inputs = inputs.to(model.device) # Inference: Generation of the output generated_ids = model.generate(**inputs, max_new_tokens=128) generated_ids_trimmed = [ out_ids[len(in_ids) :] for in_ids, out_ids in zip(inputs.input_ids, generated_ids) ] output_text = processor.batch_decode( generated_ids_trimmed, skip_special_tokens=True, clean_up_tokenization_spaces=False ) print(output_text) ```
Batch inference ```python # for batch generation, padding_side should be set to left! processor.tokenizer.padding_side = 'left' # Sample messages for batch inference messages1 = [ { "role": "user", "content": [ {"type": "image", "image": "file:///path/to/image1.jpg"}, {"type": "image", "image": "file:///path/to/image2.jpg"}, {"type": "text", "text": "What are the common elements in these pictures?"}, ], } ] messages2 = [ {"role": "system", "content": [{"type": "text", "text": "You are a helpful assistant."}]}, {"role": "user", "content": [{"type": "text", "text": "Who are you?"}]}, ] # Combine messages for batch processing messages = [messages1, messages2] # Preparation for inference inputs = processor.apply_chat_template( messages, tokenize=True, add_generation_prompt=True, return_dict=True, return_tensors="pt", padding=True # padding should be set for batch generation! ) inputs = inputs.to(model.device) # Inference: Generation of the output generated_ids = model.generate(**inputs, max_new_tokens=128) generated_ids_trimmed = [ out_ids[len(in_ids) :] for in_ids, out_ids in zip(inputs.input_ids, generated_ids) ] output_text = processor.batch_decode( generated_ids_trimmed, skip_special_tokens=True, clean_up_tokenization_spaces=False ) print(output_text) ```
Pixel Control via Official Processor Using the official HF processor, we can conveniently control the budget of visual tokens. Since the Qwen3-VL processor separates image and video processing, we can independently configure the pixel budget for each modality. - **For the image processor**: The parameter `size['longest_edge']` originally corresponds to `max_pixels`, which defines the maximum number of pixels allowed for an image (i.e., for an image of height H and width W, H × W must not exceed `max_pixels`; image channels are ignored for simplicity). Similarly, `size['shortest_edge']` corresponds to `min_pixels`, specifying the minimum allowable pixel count for an image. - **For the video processor**: The interpretation differs slightly. `size['longest_edge']` represents the maximum total number of pixels across all frames in a video — for a video of shape T×H×W, the product T×H×W must not exceed `size['longest_edge']`. Similarly, `size['shortest_edge']` sets the minimum total pixel budget for the video. ```python processor = AutoProcessor.from_pretrained("Qwen/Qwen3-VL-235B-A22B-Instruct") # budget for image processor, since the compression ratio is 32 for Qwen3-VL, we can set the number of visual tokens of a single image to 256-1280 (32× spatial compression) processor.image_processor.size = {"longest_edge": 1280*32*32, "shortest_edge": 256*32*32} # budget for video processor, we can set the number of visual tokens of a single video to 256-16384 (32× spatial compression + 2× temporal compression) processor.video_processor.size = {"longest_edge": 16384*32*32*2, "shortest_edge": 256*32*32*2} ``` - You can further control the **sample fps** or **sample frames** of video, as shown below. ```python messages = [ { "role": "user", "content": [ { "type": "video", "video": "https://qianwen-res.oss-cn-beijing.aliyuncs.com/Qwen2-VL/space_woaudio.mp4", }, {"type": "text", "text": "Describe this video."}, ], } ] # for video input, we can further control the fps or num_frames. \ # defaultly, fps is set to 2 # set fps = 4 inputs = processor.apply_chat_template( messages, tokenize=True, add_generation_prompt=True, return_dict=True, return_tensors="pt", fps=4 ) inputs = inputs.to(model.device) # set num_frames = 128 and overwrite the fps to None! # inputs = processor.apply_chat_template( # messages, # tokenize=True, # add_generation_prompt=True, # return_dict=True, # return_tensors="pt", # num_frames=128, # fps=None, # ) # inputs = inputs.to(model.device) # Inference: Generation of the output generated_ids = model.generate(**inputs, max_new_tokens=128) generated_ids_trimmed = [ out_ids[len(in_ids) :] for in_ids, out_ids in zip(inputs.input_ids, generated_ids) ] output_text = processor.batch_decode( generated_ids_trimmed, skip_special_tokens=True, clean_up_tokenization_spaces=False ) print(output_text) ```
### New `qwen-vl-utils` Usage With the latest `qwen-vl-utils` toolkit (backward compatible with Qwen2.5-VL), you can control pixel constraints per visual input. ```bash pip install qwen-vl-utils==0.0.14 # It's highly recommended to use `[decord]` feature for faster video loading. # pip install qwen-vl-utils[decord] ``` Compared to previous version, the new `qwen-vl-utils` introduces: - "image_patch_size": `14` for Qwen2.5-VL and `16` for Qwen3-VL. Default set to `14`. - "return_video_metadata"(Qwen3-VL only): Due to the new video processor, if True, each video returns as (video_tensor, video_metadata). Default set to `False`. ```python # for Qwen2.5VL, you can simply call images, videos, video_kwargs = process_vision_info(messages, return_video_kwargs=True) # For Qwen3VL series, you should call images, videos, video_kwargs = process_vision_info(messages, image_patch_size=16, return_video_kwargs=True, return_video_metadata=True) ``` 📌 Note: Since `qwen-vl-utils` already resizes images/videos, pass `do_resize=False` to the processor to avoid duplicate resizing.
Process Images For input images, we support local files, base64, and URLs. ```python # You can directly insert a local file path, a URL, or a base64-encoded image into the position where you want in the text. ## Local file path messages = [ { "role": "user", "content": [ {"type": "image", "image": "file:///path/to/your/image.jpg"}, {"type": "text", "text": "Describe this image."}, ], } ] ## Image URL messages = [ { "role": "user", "content": [ {"type": "image", "image": "http://path/to/your/image.jpg"}, {"type": "text", "text": "Describe this image."}, ], } ] ## Base64 encoded image messages = [ { "role": "user", "content": [ {"type": "image", "image": "data:image;base64,/9j/..."}, {"type": "text", "text": "Describe this image."}, ], } ] ``` We provide two methods for fine-grained control over the image size input to the model: - Specify exact dimensions: Directly set resized_height and resized_width. These values will be rounded to the nearest multiple of 32 (32 for Qwen3VL, 28 for Qwen2.5VL). - Define min_pixels and max_pixels: Images will be resized to maintain their aspect ratio within the range of min_pixels and max_pixels ```python from transformers import AutoModelForImageTextToText, AutoProcessor from qwen_vl_utils import process_vision_info model = AutoModelForImageTextToText.from_pretrained( "Qwen/Qwen3-VL-235B-A22B-Instruct", dtype="auto", device_map="auto" ) processor = AutoProcessor.from_pretrained("Qwen/Qwen3-VL-235B-A22B-Instruct") # resized_height and resized_width messages = [ { "role": "user", "content": [ { "type": "image", "image": "https://qianwen-res.oss-cn-beijing.aliyuncs.com/Qwen-VL/assets/demo.jpeg", "resized_height": 280, "resized_width": 420, }, {"type": "text", "text": "Describe this image."}, ], } ] # min_pixels and max_pixels messages = [ { "role": "user", "content": [ { "type": "image", "image": "https://qianwen-res.oss-cn-beijing.aliyuncs.com/Qwen-VL/assets/demo.jpeg", "min_pixels": 50176, "max_pixels": 50176, }, {"type": "text", "text": "Describe this image."}, ], } ] # Preparation for inference with qwen-vl-utils text = processor.apply_chat_template(messages, tokenize=False, add_generation_prompt=True) images, videos = process_vision_info(messages, image_patch_size=16) # since qwen-vl-utils has resize the images/videos, \ # we should pass do_resize=False to avoid duplicate operation in processor! inputs = processor(text=text, images=images, videos=videos, do_resize=False, return_tensors="pt") inputs = inputs.to(model.device) # Inference: Generation of the output generated_ids = model.generate(**inputs, max_new_tokens=128) generated_ids_trimmed = [ out_ids[len(in_ids) :] for in_ids, out_ids in zip(inputs.input_ids, generated_ids) ] output_text = processor.batch_decode( generated_ids_trimmed, skip_special_tokens=True, clean_up_tokenization_spaces=False ) print(output_text) ```
Process Videos For input videos, we support images lists, local path and url. ```python # Messages containing a images list as a video and a text query messages = [ { "role": "user", "content": [ { "type": "video", "video": [ "file:///path/to/frame1.jpg", "file:///path/to/frame2.jpg", "file:///path/to/frame3.jpg", "file:///path/to/frame4.jpg", ], 'sample_fps':'1', # sample_fps: frame sampling rate (frames per second), used to determine timestamps for each frame }, {"type": "text", "text": "Describe this video."}, ], } ] # Messages containing a local video path and a text query messages = [ { "role": "user", "content": [ { "type": "video", "video": "file:///path/to/video1.mp4", "max_pixels": 360 * 420, "fps": 1.0, }, {"type": "text", "text": "Describe this video."}, ], } ] # Messages containing a video url and a text query messages = [ { "role": "user", "content": [ { "type": "video", "video": "https://qianwen-res.oss-cn-beijing.aliyuncs.com/Qwen2-VL/space_woaudio.mp4", "min_pixels": 4 * 32 * 32, "max_pixels": 256 * 32 * 32, "total_pixels": 20480 * 32 * 32, }, {"type": "text", "text": "Describe this video."}, ], } ] ``` We recommend setting appropriate values for the `min_pixels` and `max_pixels` parameters based on available GPU memory and the specific application scenario to restrict the resolution of individual frames in the video. Alternatively, you can use the `total_pixels` parameter to limit the total number of tokens in the video (it is recommended to set this value below 24576 * 32 * 32 to avoid excessively long input sequences). For more details on parameter usage and processing logic, please refer to the `fetch_video` function in `qwen_vl_utils/vision_process.py`. ```python from transformers import AutoModelForImageTextToText, AutoProcessor from qwen_vl_utils import process_vision_info model = AutoModelForImageTextToText.from_pretrained( "Qwen/Qwen3-VL-235B-A22B-Instruct", dtype="auto", device_map="auto" ) processor = AutoProcessor.from_pretrained("Qwen/Qwen3-VL-235B-A22B-Instruct") messages = [ { "role": "user", "content": [ { "type": "video", "video": "https://qianwen-res.oss-cn-beijing.aliyuncs.com/Qwen2-VL/space_woaudio.mp4", "min_pixels": 4 * 32 * 32, "max_pixels": 256 * 32 * 32, "total_pixels": 20480 * 32 * 32, }, {"type": "text", "text": "Describe this video."}, ], } ] text = processor.apply_chat_template(messages, tokenize=False, add_generation_prompt=True) images, videos, video_kwargs = process_vision_info(messages, image_patch_size=16, return_video_kwargs=True, return_video_metadata=True) # split the videos and according metadatas if videos is not None: videos, video_metadatas = zip(*videos) videos, video_metadatas = list(videos), list(video_metadatas) else: video_metadatas = None # since qwen-vl-utils has resize the images/videos, \ # we should pass do_resize=False to avoid duplicate operation in processor! inputs = processor(text=text, images=images, videos=videos, video_metadata=video_metadatas, return_tensors="pt", do_resize=False, **video_kwargs) inputs = inputs.to(model.device) # Inference: Generation of the output generated_ids = model.generate(**inputs, max_new_tokens=128) generated_ids_trimmed = [ out_ids[len(in_ids) :] for in_ids, out_ids in zip(inputs.input_ids, generated_ids) ] output_text = processor.batch_decode( generated_ids_trimmed, skip_special_tokens=True, clean_up_tokenization_spaces=False ) print(output_text) ```
Video Backends and URL Compatibility Currently, `qwen-vl-utils` supports three video decoding backends: `torchvision`, `decord`, and `torchcodec`. While `decord` and `torchcodec` generally offer significantly faster decoding speeds compared to `torchvision`, we recommend using `torchcodec`. This is because `decord` has known issues, such as decoding hangs, and its project is no longer actively maintained. - For `decord`, if you are not using Linux, you might not be able to install `decord` from PyPI. In that case, you can use `pip install qwen-vl-utils` which will fall back to using torchvision for video processing. However, you can still [install decord from source](https://github.com/dmlc/decord?tab=readme-ov-file#install-from-source) to get decord used when loading video. - To use `torchcodec` as the backend for video decoding, follow the installation instructions provided in the official [torchcodec repository](https://github.com/pytorch/torchcodec/tree/main?tab=readme-ov-file#installing-torchcodec) and install it manually. Note that `torchcodec` depends on FFmpeg for decoding functionality. Video URL compatibility is primarily determined by the version of the third-party library being used. For more details, refer to the table below. If you prefer not to use the default backend, you can switch it by setting `FORCE_QWENVL_VIDEO_READER` to `torchvision`, `decord`, or `torchcodec`. | Backend | HTTP | HTTPS | |-------------|------|-------| | torchvision >= 0.19.0 | ✅ | ✅ | | torchvision < 0.19.0 | ❌ | ❌ | | decord | ✅ | ❌ | | torchcodec | ✅ | ✅ |

#### Flash-Attention 2 to speed up generation First, make sure to install the latest version of Flash Attention 2: ```bash pip install -U flash-attn --no-build-isolation ``` Also, you should have a hardware that is compatible with Flash-Attention 2. Read more about it in the official documentation of the [flash attention repository](https://github.com/Dao-AILab/flash-attention). FlashAttention-2 can only be used when a model is loaded in `torch.float16` or `torch.bfloat16`. To load and run a model using Flash Attention-2, simply add `attn_implementation="flash_attention_2"` when loading the model as follows: ```python import torch from transformers import AutoModelForImageTextToText model = AutoModelForImageTextToText.from_pretrained( "Qwen/Qwen3-VL-235B-A22B-Instruct", torch_dtype=torch.bfloat16, attn_implementation="flash_attention_2", ) ``` #### Processing Long Texts The current `config.json` is set for context length up to 256K tokens. To handle extensive inputs exceeding 256K tokens, we utilize [YaRN](https://arxiv.org/abs/2309.00071), a technique for enhancing model length extrapolation, ensuring optimal performance on lengthy texts. For supported frameworks (currently transformers and vLLM), you could modify `max_position_embeddings` and `rope_scaling` in `config.json` to enable YaRN: ``` { "max_position_embeddings": 1000000, ..., "rope_scaling": { "rope_type": "yarn", "mrope_section": [ 24, 20, 20 ], "mrope_interleaved": true, "factor": 3.0, "original_max_position_embeddings": 262144 }, ... } ``` When using vLLM for serving, you can also enable YaRN by adding the additional arguments `--rope-scaling` and `--max-model-len`. ``` vllm serve Qwen/Qwen3-VL-235B-A22B-Instruct --rope-scaling '{"rope_type":"yarn","factor":3.0,"original_max_position_embeddings": 262144,"mrope_section":[24,20,20],"mrope_interleaved": true}' --max-model-len 1000000 ``` > Because Interleaved-MRoPE’s position IDs grow more slowly than vanilla RoPE, use a **smaller scaling factor**. For example, to support 1M context with 256K context length, set factor=2 or 3 — not 4. ### Try Qwen3-VL-235B-A22 with API! #!/usr/bin/env bash
#
# This script will automatically pull docker image from DockerHub, and start a daemon container to run the Qwen-Chat web-demo.

IMAGE_NAME=qwenllm/qwenvl:qwen3vl-cu128
QWEN_CHECKPOINT_PATH='Qwen/Qwen3-VL-235B-A22B-Instruct'
PORT=8901
CONTAINER_NAME=qwen3vl

function usage() {
    echo '
Usage: bash docker/docker_web_demo.sh [-i IMAGE_NAME] -c [/path/to/Qwen-Instruct] [-n CONTAINER_NAME] [--port PORT]
'
}

while [[ "$1" != "" ]]; do
    case $1 in
        -i | --image-name )
            shift
            IMAGE_NAME=$1
            ;;
        -c | --checkpoint )
            shift
            QWEN_CHECKPOINT_PATH=$1
            ;;
        -n | --container-name )
            shift
            CONTAINER_NAME=$1
            ;;
        --port )
            shift
            PORT=$1
            ;;
        -h | --help )
            usage
            exit 0
            ;;
        * )
            echo "Unknown argument ${1}"
            exit 1
            ;;
    esac
    shift
done

if [ ! -e ${QWEN_CHECKPOINT_PATH}/config.json ]; then
    echo "Checkpoint config.json file not found in ${QWEN_CHECKPOINT_PATH}, exit."
    exit 1
fi

sudo docker pull ${IMAGE_NAME} || {
    echo "Pulling image ${IMAGE_NAME} failed, exit."
    exit 1
}

sudo docker run --gpus all -d --restart always --name ${CONTAINER_NAME} \
    -v /var/run/docker.sock:/var/run/docker.sock -p ${PORT}:80 \
    --mount type=bind,source=${QWEN_CHECKPOINT_PATH},target=/data/shared/Qwen/checkpoint \
    -it ${IMAGE_NAME} \
    python web_demo_mm.py --server-port 80 --server-name 0.0.0.0 -c /data/shared/Qwen/checkpoint/ && {
    echo "Successfully started web demo. Open 'http://localhost:${PORT}' to try!
Run \`docker logs ${CONTAINER_NAME}\` to check demo status.
Run \`docker rm -f ${CONTAINER_NAME}\` to stop and remove the demo."
}

1	# vLLM 离线推理与 prepare_inputs_for_vllm 模式
2	
3	## 1. 本讲目标
4	
5	学完本讲，你应该能够：
6	
7	1. 独立实现 `prepare_inputs_for_vllm` 函数——这是本仓库中反复出现的一段「样板代码」，出现在 web 演示、README 示例和全部五个评测脚本中。
8	2. 准确说出 vLLM 离线推理输入的三个字段 `prompt`、`multi_modal_data`、`mm_processor_kwargs` 各自承担什么职责。
9	3. 掌握视频输入的特殊处理：`return_video_metadata=True` 时返回的 `(视频张量, video_metadata)` 元组列表如何传给 vLLM，以及 `do_sample_frames=False` 这个开关为什么必须传。
10	4. 会配置 vLLM 的 `LLM` 引擎参数与 `SamplingParams` 采样参数，并用 `llm.generate` 完成一次批量离线推理。
11	
12	## 2. 前置知识
13	
14	### 2.1 vLLM 是什么
15	
16	vLLM 是一个高性能推理引擎。相比直接用 transformers 的 `model.generate`，它通过两項核心技术大幅提升吞吐：
17	
18	- **PagedAttention**：像操作系统管理内存页一样管理 KV 缓存，避免为每条请求预留整块显存。
19	- **连续批处理（continuous batching）**：新请求随时插入、完成的请求随时退出，GPU 始终满载。
20	
21	本仓库 README 明确推荐用 vLLM 部署 Qwen3-VL，并要求 `vllm>=0.11.0`（低于该版本不支持 Qwen3-VL）。
22	
23	### 2.2 离线推理 vs 在线服务
24	
25	vLLM 有两种用法，本讲只讲前者：
26	
27	| 方式 | 入口 | 适用场景 | 对应讲义 |
28	| --- | --- | --- | --- |
29	| **离线推理（offline）** | Python 里 `from vllm import LLM`，直接调用 `llm.generate(...)` | 批量跑数据、评测、一次性任务 | 本讲 |
30	| **在线服务（serving）** | 命令行 `vllm serve ...` 起一个 OpenAI 兼容 HTTP 服务 | 产品化 API 服务 | 下一讲 u3-l3 |
31	
32	「离线」不是指断网，而是指**不起网络服务、在脚本进程内直接推理**。单元六的全部评测脚本（MMMU、VideoMME、ODinW-13 等）用的都是离线方式。
33	
34	### 2.3 为什么 vLLM 需要手动准备多模态输入
35	
36	回顾上一讲（u3-l1）的 transformers 路径：`processor.apply_chat_template(messages, tokenize=True, ...)` 一步就把 messages 变成了带 `pixel_values`、`image_grid_thw` 的张量字典。**processor 帮你做了所有事**。
37	
38	vLLM 路径则把职责拆开：
39	
40	- 你的脚本负责：把视觉内容从 messages 里**真正解码出来**（下载图片、解码视频帧、按像素预算缩放）；
41	- vLLM 引擎负责：接收文本 prompt 和现成的图像/视频张量，在引擎内部调用模型自带的多模态预处理器，把占位符展开成真正的视觉 token，再完成前向与解码。
42	
43	于是就有了那个问题：谁来「真正解码」？答案就是 `qwen-vl-utils` 的 `process_vision_info`——这正是单元二花了四讲精读的库在此处派上用场。README 中也专门引用了 vLLM 官方多模态输入文档（见 [README.md:856-868](https://github.com/QwenLM/Qwen3-VL/blob/96588727e44c78b25ba03ea03b8e12f7e64fd0da/README.md#L856-L868)）。
44	
45	### 2.4 三个字段的契约预告
46	
47	`llm.generate` 接收一个字典列表，每个字典描述一条请求：
48	
49	```text
50	{
51	  'prompt':               渲染好的文本提示串（视觉位置只留占位符）
52	  'multi_modal_data':     {'image': [PIL图...], 'video': [视频...]} 现成的视觉数据
53	  'mm_processor_kwargs':  传给引擎内部处理器的关键字参数（如 do_sample_frames）
54	}
55	```
56	
57	记住这张「三件套」卡片，下面逐个拆解。
58	
59	## 3. 本讲源码地图
60	
61	| 文件 | 角色 |
62	| --- | --- |
63	| [web_demo_mm.py](https://github.com/QwenLM/Qwen3-VL/blob/96588727e44c78b25ba03ea03b8e12f7e64fd0da/web_demo_mm.py) | Gradio 网页演示，其中的 `_prepare_inputs_for_vllm` 是该模式最紧凑的实现，vLLM 双后端加载逻辑也在其中 |
64	| [README.md](https://github.com/QwenLM/Qwen3-VL/blob/96588727e44c78b25ba03ea03b8e12f7e64fd0da/README.md) | 「Offline Inference」一节给出完整的可运行 vLLM 示例脚本，是本讲的权威参照 |
65	| [qwen-vl-utils/src/qwen_vl_utils/vision_process.py](https://github.com/QwenLM/Qwen3-VL/blob/96588727e44c78b25ba03ea03b8e12f7e64fd0da/qwen-vl-utils/src/qwen_vl_utils/vision_process.py) | `process_vision_info` 的实现，决定了三个返回值（尤其 `video_kwargs`）的确切内容 |
66	| [evaluation/mmmu/run_mmmu.py](https://github.com/QwenLM/Qwen3-VL/blob/96588727e44c78b25ba03ea03b8e12f7e64fd0da/evaluation/mmmu/run_mmmu.py) | MMMU 评测脚本，逐行复用了同一模式，证明它是仓库级的「标准写法」 |
67	
68	## 4. 核心概念与源码讲解
69	
70	### 4.1 输入准备函数：prepare_inputs_for_vllm
71	
72	#### 4.1.1 概念说明
73	
74	`prepare_inputs_for_vllm` 不是 vLLM 库的 API，而是**本仓库自己约定的一个辅助函数名**：输入标准 messages 和 processor，输出 vLLM `llm.generate` 需要的那条请求字典。它解决的问题是：**把「对话 + 视觉素材」翻译成「文本 prompt + 现成张量 + 处理器开关」三部分**。
75	
76	这个函数在仓库里出现了至少 7 次，写法几乎逐行相同：
77	
78	- [web_demo_mm.py:178-198](https://github.com/QwenLM/Qwen3-VL/blob/96588727e44c78b25ba03ea03b8e12f7e64fd0da/web_demo_mm.py#L178-L198)（网页演示）
79	- [README.md:997-1018](https://github.com/QwenLM/Qwen3-VL/blob/96588727e44c78b25ba03ea03b8e12f7e64fd0da/README.md#L997-L1018)（官方离线推理示例）
80	- [evaluation/mmmu/run_mmmu.py:76-107](https://github.com/QwenLM/Qwen3-VL/blob/96588727e44c78b25ba03ea03b8e12f7e64fd0da/evaluation/mmmu/run_mmmu.py#L76-L107)（MMMU 评测，函数内注释直接写明 "following the examples in README.md"）
81	
82	此外 RealWorldQA、MathVision、VideoMME、ODinW-13 四个评测目录也各有一份同名同构实现。学会这一个函数，就看懂了仓库里所有 vLLM 推理代码的入口。
83	
84	#### 4.1.2 核心流程
85	
86	函数只有三步：
87	
88	```text
89	输入: messages（含 image/video 元素的对话）, processor
90	
91	第 1 步  渲染文本
92	    text = processor.apply_chat_template(messages, tokenize=False, add_generation_prompt=True)
93	    # tokenize=False：只产出字符串，视觉位置仅保留一个 <|image_pad|>/<|video_pad|> 占位符
94	
95	第 2 步  解码视觉素材
96	    image_inputs, video_inputs, video_kwargs = process_vision_info(
97	        messages,
98	        image_patch_size=processor.image_processor.patch_size,   # Qwen3-VL 为 16
99	        return_video_kwargs=True,                                # 额外返回 video_kwargs
100	        return_video_metadata=True                               # 视频变为 (张量, metadata) 元组
101	    )
102	
103	第 3 步  组装三件套字典并返回
104	    {'prompt': text, 'multi_modal_data': mm_data, 'mm_processor_kwargs': video_kwargs}
105	```

107	注意一个关键细节：第 1 步与第 2 步**遍历的是同一份 messages**。`apply_chat_template` 数出「有几个视觉元素、各在哪个位置」来放置占位符；`process_vision_info` 按 messages 中出现的顺序产出视觉数据。两边顺序天然对齐，vLLM 才能把第 i 个占位符对应到第 i 份视觉数据。

115	```python
116	def _prepare_inputs_for_vllm(messages, processor):
117	    """Prepare inputs for vLLM inference"""
118	    text = processor.apply_chat_template(messages, tokenize=False, add_generation_prompt=True)
119	    image_inputs, video_inputs, video_kwargs = process_vision_info(
120	        messages,
121	        image_patch_size=processor.image_processor.patch_size,
122	        return_video_kwargs=True,
123	        return_video_metadata=True
124	    )
125	
126	    mm_data = {}
127	    if image_inputs is not None:
128	        mm_data['image'] = image_inputs
129	    if video_inputs is not None:
130	        mm_data['video'] = video_inputs
131	
132	    return {
133	        'prompt': text,
134	        'multi_modal_data': mm_data,
135	        'mm_processor_kwargs': video_kwargs
136	    }
137	```

141	- `tokenize=False`：只渲染出字符串。上一讲（u3-l1）讲过，此时每张图在串里只留一个 `<|image_pad|>` 占位 token；真正的视觉 token 数量由 vLLM 引擎内部按图像实际宽高展开。
142	- `image_patch_size=processor.image_processor.patch_size`：从 processor 动态读取 patch 边长（Qwen3-VL 为 16）。这是单元二强调过的最佳实践——**不要硬编码 16**，这样同一段代码也能服务 patch 为 14 的 Qwen2.5-VL。

191	#### 4.1.5 小练习与答案
192	
193	**练习 1**：为什么 `apply_chat_template` 必须传 `tokenize=False`，而不能像 transformers 路径那样传 `tokenize=True`？
194	
195	**答案**：`tokenize=True` 会直接产出 `input_ids` 和 `pixel_values` 等**已经预处理完**的张量，那是给 `model.generate` 用的；而 vLLM 引擎要求输入是「文本串 + 原始视觉数据」，它要在引擎内部自行完成 tokenization 与视觉展开。若传 `tokenize=True`，产出对 vLLM 无从递交给引擎，且 `tokenize=False` 时每图仅留一个占位符，正适合让 vLLM 按实际视觉 token 数展开。
196	
197	**练习 2**：如果把 `image_patch_size=14`（Qwen2.5-VL 的值）误传给 Qwen3-VL，会发生什么？
198	
199	**答案**：不会报错，但 `smart_resize` 会按 patch=14 的对齐因子（28）而非 32 来缩放图像，导致图像宽高不再是 32 的倍数，视觉 token 网格被算错，模型可能表现出细微的性能下降。这就是要从 `processor.image_processor.patch_size` 动态读取、而不是硬编码的原因（见单元二 u2-l1）。

201	### 4.2 多模态数据字典 multi_modal_data
202	
203	#### 4.2.1 概念说明
204	
205	`multi_modal_data` 是 vLLM 定义的多模态输入挂载点：一个字典，键是模态名（`'image'`、`'video'`），值是**已经解码并缩放好的视觉数据列表**。vLLM 收到后，会在引擎内部把它们与 prompt 里的占位符一一对应，展开成真正的视觉 token 送入视觉编码器。
206	
207	它与 `prompt` 的分工是：**prompt 描述「视觉内容出现在对话的什么位置、有几份」，multi_modal_data 提供「视觉内容本身」**。
208	
209	图像侧的值是 PIL `Image.Image` 对象列表（`process_vision_info` 的 `fetch_image` 产出），视频侧的值则可能是张量或「张量 + 元数据」元组（见 4.3 节）。
210	
211	#### 4.2.2 核心流程
212	
213	一条含 1 图 1 视频的请求，数据流如下：
214	
215	```text
216	messages
217	  ├── apply_chat_template(tokenize=False) ──► prompt 串: "...<|image_pad|>...<|video_pad|>..."
218	  └── process_vision_info(...)
219	        ├── image_inputs = [PIL 图]        ──► mm_data['image'] = [PIL 图]
220	        └── video_inputs = [(张量, 元数据)] ──► mm_data['video'] = [(张量, 元数据)]
221	
222	vLLM 引擎内部: 按占位符顺序取 mm_data 中的数据 → 视觉编码 → 展开进序列 → 解码生成
223	```
224	
225	视觉 token 数量与图像宽高的关系（承接 u3-l1）：图像被 32×32 空间压缩，视频再叠加 2× 时间压缩。对缩放后为 \(H' \times W'\) 的单帧，\(T\) 帧视频的视觉 token 数为
226	
227	\[
228	N_{\text{video}} = \frac{H'}{32} \times \frac{W'}{32} \times \frac{T}{2}
229	\]
230	
231	这个数量不由你的脚本计算，而由 vLLM 引擎按传入张量的实际尺寸展开——你的脚本只负责把尺寸控制好（元素级 `min_pixels`/`max_pixels` 或 processor 的 `size` 预算）。
232

258	### 4.3 video_metadata 解包与 mm_processor_kwargs 传参
259	
260	#### 4.3.1 概念说明
261	
262	这是本讲最微妙也最容易踩坑的模块，涉及三件事：
263	
264	1. **`return_video_metadata=True` 改变了 `video_inputs` 的形态**。开关关闭时，`video_inputs` 是 `[视频张量, ...]`；开关打开时，每个视频变成 `(视频张量, video_metadata)` **元组**，整个 `video_inputs` 变成元组列表。`video_metadata` 记录了原视频的 `fps`、`frames_indices`（采样帧在原视频中的帧号）、`total_num_frames` 等时间档案（详见 u2-l4）——因为视频张量经过抽帧与缩放后，时间信息全部丢失，必须由 metadata 随帧携带，才能支撑 Qwen3-VL 的「文本-时间戳对齐」。
265	2. **`mm_processor_kwargs` 的核心内容是 `do_sample_frames=False`**。`qwen-vl-utils` 在库内**已经完成了帧采样**（按 `fps` 或 `nframes` 抽帧），如果引擎内部的处理器再采样一次，帧数就会错一倍。这个开关告诉处理器「帧已采好，别再动」。
266	3. **vLLM 路径与 transformers 路径的解包方式不同**。vLLM 直接收元组列表；transformers 手动调用 processor 时必须先 `zip(*)` 拆开再分别传参。这是两条路径最大的写法差异。
267	
268	#### 4.3.2 核心流程
269	
270	`process_vision_info` 内部如何构造 `video_kwargs`（这是 `mm_processor_kwargs` 的直接来源）：
271	
272	```text
273	video_kwargs = {'do_sample_frames': False}          # 恒有：帧已在库内采样完
274	if not return_video_metadata:                       # 仅 Qwen2.5-VL 兼容分支
275	    video_kwargs.update({'fps': video_sample_fps_list})
276	```
277	
278	于是形成清晰的版本分工：
279	
280	- **Qwen3-VL**（`return_video_metadata=True`）：`video_kwargs = {'do_sample_frames': False}`，时间信息走 metadata；
281	- **Qwen2.5-VL 兼容模式**（`return_video_metadata=False`）：`video_kwargs` 额外带 `fps` 列表，时间信息靠 T-RoPE 的 fps 重建。
282	
283	两条路径的视频传参对比：
284	
285	```text
286	vLLM 路径（本讲）:
287	    mm_data['video'] = [(张量1, 元数据1), (张量2, 元数据2), ...]   # 元组列表整体直传
288	    mm_processor_kwargs = {'do_sample_frames': False}
289	
290	transformers 路径（对比, README "Process Videos" 示例）:
291	    videos, video_metadatas = zip(*videos)   # 手动拆元组
292	    videos, video_metadatas = list(videos), list(video_metadatas)
293	    processor(text=text, videos=videos, video_metadata=video_metadatas,
294	              do_resize=False, **video_kwargs)
295	```
296	
297	#### 4.3.3 源码精读
298	
299	[qwen-vl-utils/src/qwen_vl_utils/vision_process.py:528-530](https://github.com/QwenLM/Qwen3-VL/blob/96588727e44c78b25ba03ea03b8e12f7e64fd0da/qwen-vl-utils/src/qwen_vl_utils/vision_process.py#L528-L530) —— `video_kwargs` 的构造现场：第 528 行先放入 `do_sample_frames: False`；第 529-530 行仅在 `return_video_metadata=False`（Qwen2.5-VL 向后兼容分支）时追加 `fps` 列表。这解释了为什么 Qwen3-VL 模式下打印 `video_kwargs` 只会看到一个键。
300	
301	[qwen-vl-utils/src/qwen_vl_utils/vision_process.py:517-520](https://github.com/QwenLM/Qwen3-VL/blob/96588727e44c78b25ba03ea03b8e12f7e64fd0da/qwen-vl-utils/src/qwen_vl_utils/vision_process.py#L517-L520) —— 视频元素的解码入口：对每个 video 元素调用 `fetch_video(..., return_video_metadata=return_video_metadata)`，返回值直接 `append` 进 `video_inputs`。当开关为 True 时，`fetch_video` 返回的就是 `(视频输入, 实际采样率)` 二元组、且其中的视频输入本身又是 `(张量, metadata)`——所以 `video_inputs` 最终是元组的列表，这正是 4.2 节 `mm_data['video']` 直传的形态。
302	
303	[README.md:643-651](https://github.com/QwenLM/Qwen3-VL/blob/96588727e44c78b25ba03ea03b8e12f7e64fd0da/README.md#L643-L651) —— transformers 路径的「手动解包」对照组：第 643-645 行用 `zip(*videos)` 把元组列表拆成 `videos` 与 `video_metadatas` 两个列表，第 651 行分别以 `videos=` 与 `video_metadata=` 传给 processor，同时传 `do_resize=False` 和 `**video_kwargs`。**注意 README 在这段代码注释里明确写了 "split the videos and according metadatas"**——这一步在 transformers 路径必须手动做，而 vLLM 路径（web_demo 与离线示例）直接把 `video_inputs` 塞进 `mm_data['video']`，解包由 vLLM 引擎内部完成。
304	
305	[README.md:965-975](https://github.com/QwenLM/Qwen3-VL/blob/96588727e44c78b25ba03ea03b8e12f7e64fd0da/README.md#L965-L975) —— 在线服务场景下的同类机制佐证：官方注释说明默认 `fps=2`、`do_sample_frames=True`（由服务端采样），可通过请求体 `extra_body={"mm_processor_kwargs": {"fps": 2, "do_sample_frames": True}}` 覆盖。可见 `do_sample_frames` 是贯穿离线与在线的同一个处理器开关：**谁来采样，谁就把开关置 False**——离线路径采样发生在 `qwen-vl-utils`，故传 False。

338	```
339	
340	3. **需要观察的现象**：第一次调用中 `vids[0]` 是长度为 2 的 tuple，第二项是含 `fps`、`frames_indices`、`total_num_frames` 等字段的 metadata；第二次调用中 `vids2[0]` 直接是张量，`kwargs2` 多出 `fps` 键。
341	4. **预期结果**：两种模式的差异与上文注释一致。待本地验证。
342	
343	#### 4.3.5 小练习与答案
344	
345	**练习 1**：vLLM 路径里，视频的 `(张量, metadata)` 元组需要像 transformers 路径那样先 `zip(*)` 拆开吗？
346	
347	**答案**：不需要。按官方示例（web_demo_mm.py 与 README 离线示例），`mm_data['video']` 直接接收元组列表，vLLM 引擎内部会处理元数据。`zip(*)` 拆包只发生在 transformers 手动调用 `processor(text=..., videos=..., video_metadata=...)` 的路径（README "Process Videos" 示例），因为那里 `videos` 与 `video_metadata` 是两个独立参数。
348	
349	**练习 2**：如果忘记把 `video_kwargs`（含 `do_sample_frames=False`）传给 `mm_processor_kwargs`，最可能发生什么？
350	
351	**答案**：处理器会按默认行为（`do_sample_frames=True`，默认 `fps=2`）对已采样好的帧序列**再抽一次帧**，输入视频的帧数可能减半，时间轴信息随之错乱，模型的视频理解与时间定位会明显劣化，且不一定会抛出异常——属于典型的「静默出错」。
352	
353	**练习 3**：为什么 Qwen3-VL 模式下 `video_kwargs` 里不再携带 `fps` 列表？
354	
355	**答案**：因为时间信息已由 `video_metadata`（含原视频 `fps` 与每帧 `frames_indices`）显式携带，时间戳 = 帧号 ÷ fps 可以直接算出；而 Qwen2.5-VL 的 T-RoPE 需要靠 `fps` 列表在位置编码里隐式恢复时间。前者以 `return_video_metadata=True` 为前提，后者是 `return_video_metadata=False` 的兼容分支（见 vision_process.py 第 529-530 行的条件）。
356	
357	### 4.4 引擎初始化与 SamplingParams
358	
359	#### 4.4.1 概念说明
360	
361	准备好请求字典后，还差两块拼图：
362	
363	- **`LLM(...)`**：离线推理引擎对象。构造时完成权重加载、KV 缓存池分配，关键参数围绕「并行度」与「显存」。
364	- **`SamplingParams`**：采样参数。决定「贪心还是随机」「最多生成几个 token」等解码行为，与视觉输入无关，但多模态长输入下 `max_tokens` 要给足。
365	
366	最后 `llm.generate(inputs, sampling_params=...)` 把请求列表整批送入引擎，返回与输入等长的输出列表，每项的 `output.outputs[0].text` 就是生成文本。注意与 transformers 的一个差异：**vLLM 返回的只有新生成部分，不需要像 transformers 那样裁剪输入前缀**。
367	
368	#### 4.4.2 核心流程
369	
370	```text
371	引擎初始化
372	  os.environ['VLLM_WORKER_MULTIPROC_METHOD'] = 'spawn'   # 多卡 worker 用 spawn 启动
373	  tensor_parallel_size = torch.cuda.device_count()        # 未指定时默认用满全部 GPU
374	  llm = LLM(model=..., tensor_parallel_size=..., gpu_memory_utilization=..., seed=0)
375	
376	批量推理
377	  inputs = [prepare_inputs_for_vllm(m, processor) for m in all_messages]  # 每条请求一个字典
378	  outputs = llm.generate(inputs, sampling_params=SamplingParams(...))
379	  for output in outputs:
380	      text = output.outputs[0].text        # 直接是新生成文本，无需裁剪
381	```
382	
383	其中「张量并行」指把单层权重切到多卡上并行计算，是比数据并行更细粒度的多卡协作方式，适合单卡放不下的大模型。
384	
385	#### 4.4.3 源码精读
386	
387	**引擎初始化——web 演示版**：
388	
389	[web_demo_mm.py:71-88](https://github.com/QwenLM/Qwen3-VL/blob/96588727e44c78b25ba03ea03b8e12f7e64fd0da/web_demo_mm.py#L71-L88) —— vLLM 后端的完整加载逻辑：第 71 行设置 `VLLM_WORKER_MULTIPROC_METHOD='spawn'`（避免 fork 方式与 CUDA 初始化冲突）；第 72-74 行在用户未指定 `--tensor-parallel-size` 时默认取 `torch.cuda.device_count()`（用满所有可见 GPU）；第 77-84 行构造 `LLM`，传入 `trust_remote_code=True`、`gpu_memory_utilization`（默认 0.70，即 vLLM 最多可占用该比例显存）、`enforce_eager=False`（允许 CUDA graph 加速）与 `seed=0`（固定随机种子保证可复现）；第 87 行单独加载 `AutoProcessor`——**vLLM 引擎负责生成，processor 在你手里负责准备输入**，这正是 `_prepare_inputs_for_vllm(messages, processor)` 需要 processor 参数的原因。
390	
391	**引擎初始化——README 离线示例版（MoE 大模型姿势）**：
392	
393	[README.md:994-995](https://github.com/QwenLM/Qwen3-VL/blob/96588727e44c78b25ba03ea03b8e12f7e64fd0da/README.md#L994-L995) —— 脚本开头同样设置 `spawn` 环境变量，说明这是离线推理的标准前奏。
394	
395	[README.md:1053-1059](https://github.com/QwenLM/Qwen3-VL/blob/96588727e44c78b25ba03ea03b8e12f7e64fd0da/README.md#L1053-L1059) —— 针对 235B MoE 模型的引擎参数：`mm_encoder_tp_mode="data"`（视觉编码器按数据切分而非按张量切分，降低多卡下的显存与通信开销）、`enable_expert_parallel=True`（MoE 专家并行）、`tensor_parallel_size=torch.cuda.device_count()`。小模型（如 2B）不需要这两个 MoE/编码器参数，只留 `model`、`tensor_parallel_size`、`seed` 即可。
396	
397	**请求构造与批量推理**：
398	
399	[README.md:1048-1051](https://github.com/QwenLM/Qwen3-VL/blob/96588727e44c78b25ba03ea03b8e12f7e64fd0da/README.md#L1048-L1051) —— 批量的本质就是一个列表推导：对每份 messages 各调用一次 `prepare_inputs_for_vllm`，得到请求字典列表。想跑多少条就放多少份 messages。
400	
401	[README.md:1061-1066](https://github.com/QwenLM/Qwen3-VL/blob/96588727e44c78b25ba03ea03b8e12f7e64fd0da/README.md#L1061-L1066) —— 官方示例的 `SamplingParams`：`temperature=0`（贪心解码，评测首选，保证可复现）、`max_tokens=1024`、`top_k=-1`（不截断候选集）、`stop_token_ids=[]`（不额外设停止 token）。对照 [README.md:1142-1164](https://github.com/QwenLM/Qwen3-VL/blob/96588727e44c78b25ba03ea03b8e12f7e64fd0da/README.md#L1142-L1164) 的官方评测超参可知产品级配置更细：Instruct 档用 `temperature=0.7, top_p=0.8, top_k=20, presence_penalty=1.5`，Thinking 档用 `temperature=0.6, top_p=0.95, presence_penalty=0` 且 `out_seq_length=40960`——思考型模型要留足输出长度。
402	
403	[web_demo_mm.py:206-217](https://github.com/QwenLM/Qwen3-VL/blob/96588727e44c78b25ba03ea03b8e12f7e64fd0da/web_demo_mm.py#L206-L217) —— 网页演示中的最小用法：`inputs = _prepare_inputs_for_vllm(messages, processor)` 后直接 `SamplingParams(max_tokens=1024)`，随后 `for output in model.generate(inputs, sampling_params=...)` 遍历输出、取 `completion.text` 累积为回复文本。注意这里传给 `generate` 的是**单个字典而非列表**——vLLM 会自动把单条请求包装成批量，两种写法都合法。
404	
405	#### 4.4.4 代码实践
406	
407	1. **实践目标**：对比贪心与采样两种 `SamplingParams` 对同一输入的输出稳定性。
408	2. **操作步骤**：在综合实践（第 5 节）的脚本中准备两组参数——`SamplingParams(temperature=0, max_tokens=256)` 与 `SamplingParams(temperature=0.7, top_p=0.8, top_k=20, max_tokens=256, seed=1234)`——对同一张图各跑两次推理。
409	3. **需要观察的现象**：贪心组两次输出完全相同；采样组两次输出通常不同（若设了 seed 则同 seed 下可复现）。
410	4. **预期结果**：贪心 = 确定性；采样 = 多样性。待本地验证。
411	
412	#### 4.4.5 小练习与答案
413	
414	**练习 1**：web 演示中 `--tensor-parallel-size` 不传时的默认行为是什么？为什么这个默认值是合理的？
415	
416	**答案**：默认取 `torch.cuda.device_count()`，即用满当前进程可见的全部 GPU 作为张量并行组（web_demo_mm.py 第 57-60 行定义参数、第 72-74 行实现默认值）。对演示场景而言，单卡能放下就用 1 卡，多卡则自动分摊权重，用户无需关心机器拓扑。
417	
418	**练习 2**：transformers 推理要用 `out_ids[len(in_ids):]` 裁剪输出，vLLM 需要吗？
419	
420	**答案**：不需要。transformers 的 `model.generate` 返回「输入 + 新生成」拼接后的完整 id 序列，所以要裁剪前缀；vLLM 的 `output.outputs[0].text` 只包含新生成文本（web_demo_mm.py 第 213-217 行直接取 `completion.text` 使用即是佐证）。
421	
422	**练习 3**：为什么 235B-A22B 示例要加 `mm_encoder_tp_mode="data"`，而 2B 示例不需要？
423	
424	**答案**：该参数控制视觉编码器在张量并行下的切分方式：大模型并行度高时，按数据切分（每卡各处理一部分图像）比按张量切分更省显存与通信。2B 模型通常单卡即可放下（`tensor_parallel_size=1`），不存在编码器切分问题，无需该参数。详见 README 部署一节引用的 vLLM 社区指南。
425	
426	## 5. 综合实践：批量离线推理脚本（2 张图 + 1 个视频）
427	
428	把本讲四个模块串成一个可运行的脚本：对 2 张图片请求和 1 个视频请求共 3 条输入做**一次批量**离线推理，并正确处理 `do_sample_frames` 与 `video_metadata`。
429	
430	**实践目标**：独立写出自己的第一个 Qwen3-VL + vLLM 离线推理脚本。
431	
432	**操作步骤**：
433	
434	1. 安装依赖（版本要求来自 [README.md:856-868](https://github.com/QwenLM/Qwen3-VL/blob/96588727e44c78b25ba03ea03b8e12f7e64fd0da/README.md#L856-L868)）：
435	
436	```bash
437	pip install "transformers>=4.57.0" "vllm>=0.11.0" qwen-vl-utils==0.0.14 accelerate
438	```
439	
440	2. 编写 `offline_infer.py`（示例代码，参照 [README.md:986-1080](https://github.com/QwenLM/Qwen3-VL/blob/96588727e44c78b25ba03ea03b8e12f7e64fd0da/README.md#L986-L1080) 官方示例改写）：
441	
442	```python
443	# -*- coding: utf-8 -*-
444	import os
445	import torch
446	from qwen_vl_utils import process_vision_info
447	from transformers import AutoProcessor
448	from vllm import LLM, SamplingParams
449	
450	os.environ['VLLM_WORKER_MULTIPROC_METHOD'] = 'spawn'
451	
452	IMG1 = "https://qianwen-res.oss-cn-beijing.aliyuncs.com/Qwen-VL/assets/demo.jpeg"
453	IMG2 = "https://qianwen-res.oss-cn-beijing.aliyuncs.com/Qwen2-VL/assets/demo.jpeg"  # 换成你自己的第二张图
454	VID  = "https://qianwen-res.oss-cn-beijing.aliyuncs.com/Qwen2-VL/space_woaudio.mp4"
455	
456	
457	def prepare_inputs_for_vllm(messages, processor):
458	    """三件套: prompt + multi_modal_data + mm_processor_kwargs"""
459	    text = processor.apply_chat_template(messages, tokenize=False, add_generation_prompt=True)
460	    image_inputs, video_inputs, video_kwargs = process_vision_info(
461	        messages,
462	        image_patch_size=processor.image_processor.patch_size,  # 动态读取, Qwen3-VL 为 16
463	        return_video_kwargs=True,
464	        return_video_metadata=True,   # 视频 -> (张量, metadata) 元组列表
465	    )
466	    print(f"video_kwargs: {video_kwargs}")   # 预期 {'do_sample_frames': False}
467	
468	    mm_data = {}
469	    if image_inputs is not None:
470	        mm_data['image'] = image_inputs      # PIL 列表直传
471	    if video_inputs is not None:
472	        mm_data['video'] = video_inputs      # 元组列表直传, 由 vLLM 解包
473	    return {
474	        'prompt': text,
475	        'multi_modal_data': mm_data,
476	        'mm_processor_kwargs': video_kwargs, # 防止引擎内二次抽帧
477	    }
478	
479	
480	if __name__ == '__main__':
481	    ckpt = "Qwen/Qwen3-VL-2B-Instruct"
482	    processor = AutoProcessor.from_pretrained(ckpt)
483	
484	    all_messages = [
485	        [  # 请求 1: 单图
486	            {"role": "user", "content": [
487	                {"type": "image", "image": IMG1},
488	                {"type": "text", "text": "Describe this image."},
489	            ]},
490	        ],
491	        [  # 请求 2: 单图
492	            {"role": "user", "content": [
493	                {"type": "image", "image": IMG2},
494	                {"type": "text", "text": "What is in this image?"},
495	            ]},
496	        ],
497	        [  # 请求 3: 视频
498	            {"role": "user", "content": [
499	                {"type": "video", "video": VID},
500	                {"type": "text", "text": "Describe this video."},
501	            ]},
502	        ],
503	    ]
504	
505	    inputs = [prepare_inputs_for_vllm(m, processor) for m in all_messages]
506	
507	    llm = LLM(model=ckpt, tensor_parallel_size=min(1, torch.cuda.device_count()), seed=0)
508	    sampling_params = SamplingParams(temperature=0, max_tokens=512)
509	
510	    outputs = llm.generate(inputs, sampling_params=sampling_params)
511	    for i, output in enumerate(outputs):
512	        print("=" * 40)
513	        print(f"[{i}] prompt 长度: {len(output.prompt_token_ids)} tokens")
514	        print(f"[{i}] 生成文本: {output.outputs[0].text}")
515	```
516	
517	3. 运行：`python offline_infer.py`。
518	
519	**需要观察的现象**：
520	
521	1. 三条请求的 `video_kwargs` 打印——前两条（纯图）与第三条（视频）都应输出 `{'do_sample_frames': False}`；
522	2. 请求 3 的 `mm_data` 含 `'video'` 键且值为长度 1 的元组列表，元组第二项是含 `fps`、`frames_indices`、`total_num_frames` 的 metadata；
523	3. `output.outputs[0].text` 直接就是生成文本，无需任何前缀裁剪；
524	4. vLLM 的连续批处理日志中三条请求在同一次 `generate` 调用内完成调度。
525	
526	**预期结果**：三段与各图/视频内容相符的描述文本；图像请求的 `mm_data` 只有 `'image'` 键。全流程显存不足以运行 2B 模型时，可改用官方 Docker 镜像（见 [README.md:1167-1173](https://github.com/QwenLM/Qwen3-VL/blob/96588727e44c78b25ba03ea03b8e12f7e64fd0da/README.md#L1167-L1173)）。**本实践未在编写本讲义时实际运行，待本地验证。**
527	
528	## 6. 本讲小结
529	
530	- `prepare_inputs_for_vllm` 是仓库级标准模式，在 web 演示、README 示例与全部五个评测目录中逐行同构地出现，核心是三步：`apply_chat_template(tokenize=False)` 渲染文本 → `process_vision_info` 解码视觉素材 → 组装三件套字典。
531	- 三字段契约：`prompt` 只含占位符的文本串；`multi_modal_data` 按 `'image'`/`'video'` 键挂载现成 PIL/张量数据，且只在模态真实存在时填键；`mm_processor_kwargs` 传递处理器开关。
532	- Qwen3-VL 视频必须 `return_video_metadata=True`：视频变为 `(张量, metadata)` 元组列表，vLLM 路径直传由引擎解包，transformers 路径才需手动 `zip(*)`；`video_kwargs` 恒含 `do_sample_frames=False`，防止引擎对已采样的帧二次抽帧。
533	- 引擎与采样：`LLM(...)` 关注张量并行与显存比例，MoE 大模型加 `mm_encoder_tp_mode="data"` 与专家并行；`SamplingParams` 中 `temperature=0` 是评测贪心档，官方 Instruct/Thinking 产品档超参不同。
534	- vLLM 输出只含新生成部分，直接取 `output.outputs[0].text`，无需 transformers 式的前缀裁剪。
535	
536	## 7. 下一步学习建议
537	
538	- **下一讲 u3-l3（在线服务部署）**：把本讲的离线引擎换成 `vllm serve` 常驻服务，用 OpenAI SDK 发 `image_url`/`video_url` 请求，并理解 `extra_body.mm_processor_kwargs` 与本讲 `mm_processor_kwargs` 的对应关系。
539	- **单元六（评测体系）**：`evaluation/mmmu/run_mmmu.py` 的 `prepare_inputs_for_vllm`（第 76-107 行）与本讲逐行一致，学完本讲可直接读懂评测主循环，届时重点看它如何按数据集设定 `MIN_PIXELS/MAX_PIXELS` 并批量组装 messages。
540	- **延伸阅读**：README 部署一节引用的 [vLLM 多模态输入官方文档](https://docs.vllm.ai/en/latest/serving/multimodal_inputs.html)，可进一步了解 `multi_modal_data` 支持的全部模态与格式。

# vLLM 离线推理与 prepare_inputs_for_vllm 模式

## 1. 本讲目标

学完本讲，你应该能够：

1. 独立实现 `prepare_inputs_for_vllm` 函数——这是本仓库中反复出现的一段「样板代码」，出现在 web 演示、README 示例和全部五个评测脚本中。
2. 准确说出 vLLM 离线推理输入的三个字段 `prompt`、`multi_modal_data`、`mm_processor_kwargs` 各自承担什么职责。
3. 掌握视频输入的特殊处理：`return_video_metadata=True` 时返回的 `(视频张量, video_metadata)` 元组列表如何传给 vLLM，以及 `do_sample_frames=False` 这个开关为什么必须传。
4. 会配置 vLLM 的 `LLM` 引擎参数与 `SamplingParams` 采样参数，并用 `llm.generate` 完成一次批量离线推理。

## 2. 前置知识

### 2.1 vLLM 是什么

vLLM 是一个高性能推理引擎。相比直接用 transformers 的 `model.generate`，它通过两項核心技术大幅提升吞吐：

- **PagedAttention**：像操作系统管理内存页一样管理 KV 缓存，避免为每条请求预留整块显存。
- **连续批处理（continuous batching）**：新请求随时插入、完成的请求随时退出，GPU 始终满载。

本仓库 README 明确推荐用 vLLM 部署 Qwen3-VL，并要求 `vllm>=0.11.0`（低于该版本不支持 Qwen3-VL）。

### 2.2 离线推理 vs 在线服务

vLLM 有两种用法，本讲只讲前者：

| 方式 | 入口 | 适用场景 | 对应讲义 |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| **离线推理（offline）** | Python 里 `from vllm import LLM`，直接调用 `llm.generate(...)` | 批量跑数据、评测、一次性任务 | 本讲 |
| **在线服务（serving）** | 命令行 `vllm serve ...` 起一个 OpenAI 兼容 HTTP 服务 | 产品化 API 服务 | 下一讲 u3-l3 |

「离线」不是指断网，而是指**不起网络服务、在脚本进程内直接推理**。单元六的全部评测脚本（MMMU、VideoMME、ODinW-13 等）用的都是离线方式。

### 2.3 为什么 vLLM 需要手动准备多模态输入

回顾上一讲（u3-l1）的 transformers 路径：`processor.apply_chat_template(messages, tokenize=True, ...)` 一步就把 messages 变成了带 `pixel_values`、`image_grid_thw` 的张量字典。**processor 帮你做了所有事**。

vLLM 路径则把职责拆开：

- 你的脚本负责：把视觉内容从 messages 里**真正解码出来**（下载图片、解码视频帧、按像素预算缩放）；
- vLLM 引擎负责：接收文本 prompt 和现成的图像/视频张量，在引擎内部调用模型自带的多模态预处理器，把占位符展开成真正的视觉 token，再完成前向与解码。

于是就有了那个问题：谁来「真正解码」？答案就是 `qwen-vl-utils` 的 `process_vision_info`——这正是单元二花了四讲精读的库在此处派上用场。README 中也专门引用了 vLLM 官方多模态输入文档（见 [README.md:856-868](https://github.com/QwenLM/Qwen3-VL/blob/96588727e44c78b25ba03ea03b8e12f7e64fd0da/README.md#L856-L868)）。

### 2.4 三个字段的契约预告

`llm.generate` 接收一个字典列表，每个字典描述一条请求：

```text
{
  'prompt':               渲染好的文本提示串（视觉位置只留占位符）
  'multi_modal_data':     {'image': [PIL图...], 'video': [视频...]} 现成的视觉数据
  'mm_processor_kwargs':  传给引擎内部处理器的关键字参数（如 do_sample_frames）
}
```

记住这张「三件套」卡片，下面逐个拆解。

## 4. 核心概念与源码讲解

### 4.1 输入准备函数：prepare_inputs_for_vllm

#### 4.1.1 概念说明

`prepare_inputs_for_vllm` 不是 vLLM 库的 API，而是**本仓库自己约定的一个辅助函数名**：输入标准 messages 和 processor，输出 vLLM `llm.generate` 需要的那条请求字典。它解决的问题是：**把「对话 + 视觉素材」翻译成「文本 prompt + 现成张量 + 处理器开关」三部分**。

这个函数在仓库里出现了至少 7 次，写法几乎逐行相同：

- [web_demo_mm.py:178-198](https://github.com/QwenLM/Qwen3-VL/blob/96588727e44c78b25ba03ea03b8e12f7e64fd0da/web_demo_mm.py#L178-L198)（网页演示）
- [README.md:997-1018](https://github.com/QwenLM/Qwen3-VL/blob/96588727e44c78b25ba03ea03b8e12f7e64fd0da/README.md#L997-L1018)（官方离线推理示例）
- [evaluation/mmmu/run_mmmu.py:76-107](https://github.com/QwenLM/Qwen3-VL/blob/96588727e44c78b25ba03ea03b8e12f7e64fd0da/evaluation/mmmu/run_mmmu.py#L76-L107)（MMMU 评测，函数内注释直接写明 "following the examples in README.md"）

此外 RealWorldQA、MathVision、VideoMME、ODinW-13 四个评测目录也各有一份同名同构实现。学会这一个函数，就看懂了仓库里所有 vLLM 推理代码的入口。

#### 4.1.2 核心流程

函数只有三步：

```text
输入: messages（含 image/video 元素的对话）, processor

第 1 步  渲染文本
    text = processor.apply_chat_template(messages, tokenize=False, add_generation_prompt=True)
    # tokenize=False：只产出字符串，视觉位置仅保留一个 <|image_pad|>/<|video_pad|> 占位符

第 2 步  解码视觉素材
    image_inputs, video_inputs, video_kwargs = process_vision_info(
        messages,
        image_patch_size=processor.image_processor.patch_size,   # Qwen3-VL 为 16
        return_video_kwargs=True,                                # 额外返回 video_kwargs
        return_video_metadata=True                               # 视频变为 (张量, metadata) 元组
    )

第 3 步  组装三件套字典并返回
    {'prompt': text, 'multi_modal_data': mm_data, 'mm_processor_kwargs': video_kwargs}
```

注意一个关键细节：第 1 步与第 2 步**遍历的是同一份 messages**。`apply_chat_template` 数出「有几个视觉元素、各在哪个位置」来放置占位符；`process_vision_info` 按 messages 中出现的顺序产出视觉数据。两边顺序天然对齐，vLLM 才能把第 i 个占位符对应到第 i 份视觉数据。

#### 4.1.3 源码精读

先看最紧凑的 web 演示版本：

[web_demo_mm.py:178-198](https://github.com/QwenLM/Qwen3-VL/blob/96588727e44c78b25ba03ea03b8e12f7e64fd0da/web_demo_mm.py#L178-L198) —— `_prepare_inputs_for_vllm` 完整实现：

```python
def _prepare_inputs_for_vllm(messages, processor):
    """Prepare inputs for vLLM inference"""
    text = processor.apply_chat_template(messages, tokenize=False, add_generation_prompt=True)
    image_inputs, video_inputs, video_kwargs = process_vision_info(
        messages,
        image_patch_size=processor.image_processor.patch_size,
        return_video_kwargs=True,
        return_video_metadata=True
    )

    mm_data = {}
    if image_inputs is not None:
        mm_data['image'] = image_inputs
    if video_inputs is not None:
        mm_data['video'] = video_inputs

    return {
        'prompt': text,
        'multi_modal_data': mm_data,
        'mm_processor_kwargs': video_kwargs
    }
```

逐段说明：

- `tokenize=False`：只渲染出字符串。上一讲（u3-l1）讲过，此时每张图在串里只留一个 `<|image_pad|>` 占位 token；真正的视觉 token 数量由 vLLM 引擎内部按图像实际宽高展开。
- `image_patch_size=processor.image_processor.patch_size`：从 processor 动态读取 patch 边长（Qwen3-VL 为 16）。这是单元二强调过的最佳实践——**不要硬编码 16**，这样同一段代码也能服务 patch 为 14 的 Qwen2.5-VL。
- `return_video_kwargs=True` 与 `return_video_metadata=True`：两个开关同时打开，含义见 4.3 节。
- `mm_data` 只在对应输入非 `None` 时才填键：纯图请求就不会有 `'video'` 键，纯文本请求 `mm_data` 是空字典。

再看 README 的离线示例版本，它多了一行版本提示：

[README.md:1000-1005](https://github.com/QwenLM/Qwen3-VL/blob/96588727e44c78b25ba03ea03b8e12f7e64fd0da/README.md#L1000-L1005) —— 官方示例的 `process_vision_info` 调用，其上一行注释标注 `qwen_vl_utils 0.0.14+ reqired`（原文如此）：`return_video_metadata` 是 0.0.14 才加入的参数，旧版本会因不认识该关键字而报错。安装命令见 [README.md:864-867](https://github.com/QwenLM/Qwen3-VL/blob/96588727e44c78b25ba03ea03b8e12f7e64fd0da/README.md#L864-L867)（`pip install qwen-vl-utils==0.0.14`）。

最后看评测目录的复用，确认「标准写法」的稳定性：

[evaluation/mmmu/run_mmmu.py:87-95](https://github.com/QwenLM/Qwen3-VL/blob/96588727e44c78b25ba03ea03b8e12f7e64fd0da/evaluation/mmmu/run_mmmu.py#L87-L95) —— MMMU 评测中的同款调用：先 `apply_chat_template(tokenize=False)`，再以完全相同的三个开关调用 `process_vision_info`。函数结尾同样返回三字段字典（[evaluation/mmmu/run_mmmu.py:103-107](https://github.com/QwenLM/Qwen3-VL/blob/96588727e44c78b25ba03ea03b8e12f7e64fd0da/evaluation/mmmu/run_mmmu.py#L103-L107)）。

#### 4.1.5 小练习与答案

**练习 1**：为什么 `apply_chat_template` 必须传 `tokenize=False`，而不能像 transformers 路径那样传 `tokenize=True`？

**答案**：`tokenize=True` 会直接产出 `input_ids` 和 `pixel_values` 等**已经预处理完**的张量，那是给 `model.generate` 用的；而 vLLM 引擎要求输入是「文本串 + 原始视觉数据」，它要在引擎内部自行完成 tokenization 与视觉展开。若传 `tokenize=True`，产出对 vLLM 无从递交给引擎，且 `tokenize=False` 时每图仅留一个占位符，正适合让 vLLM 按实际视觉 token 数展开。

**练习 2**：如果把 `image_patch_size=14`（Qwen2.5-VL 的值）误传给 Qwen3-VL，会发生什么？

**答案**：不会报错，但 `smart_resize` 会按 patch=14 的对齐因子（28）而非 32 来缩放图像，导致图像宽高不再是 32 的倍数，视觉 token 网格被算错，模型可能表现出细微的性能下降。这就是要从 `processor.image_processor.patch_size` 动态读取、而不是硬编码的原因（见单元二 u2-l1）。

### 4.2 多模态数据字典 multi_modal_data

#### 4.2.1 概念说明

`multi_modal_data` 是 vLLM 定义的多模态输入挂载点：一个字典，键是模态名（`'image'`、`'video'`），值是**已经解码并缩放好的视觉数据列表**。vLLM 收到后，会在引擎内部把它们与 prompt 里的占位符一一对应，展开成真正的视觉 token 送入视觉编码器。

它与 `prompt` 的分工是：**prompt 描述「视觉内容出现在对话的什么位置、有几份」，multi_modal_data 提供「视觉内容本身」**。

图像侧的值是 PIL `Image.Image` 对象列表（`process_vision_info` 的 `fetch_image` 产出），视频侧的值则可能是张量或「张量 + 元数据」元组（见 4.3 节）。

#### 4.2.2 核心流程

一条含 1 图 1 视频的请求，数据流如下：

```text
messages
  ├── apply_chat_template(tokenize=False) ──► prompt 串: "...<|image_pad|>...<|video_pad|>..."
  └── process_vision_info(...)
        ├── image_inputs = [PIL 图]        ──► mm_data['image'] = [PIL 图]
        └── video_inputs = [(张量, 元数据)] ──► mm_data['video'] = [(张量, 元数据)]

vLLM 引擎内部: 按占位符顺序取 mm_data 中的数据 → 视觉编码 → 展开进序列 → 解码生成
```

视觉 token 数量与图像宽高的关系（承接 u3-l1）：图像被 32×32 空间压缩，视频再叠加 2× 时间压缩。对缩放后为 \(H' \times W'\) 的单帧，\(T\) 帧视频的视觉 token 数为

\[
N_{\text{video}} = \frac{H'}{32} \times \frac{W'}{32} \times \frac{T}{2}
\]

这个数量不由你的脚本计算，而由 vLLM 引擎按传入张量的实际尺寸展开——你的脚本只负责把尺寸控制好（元素级 `min_pixels`/`max_pixels` 或 processor 的 `size` 预算）。

#### 4.2.3 源码精读

[web_demo_mm.py:188-192](https://github.com/QwenLM/Qwen3-VL/blob/96588727e44c78b25ba03ea03b8e12f7e64fd0da/web_demo_mm.py#L188-L192) —— 组装 `mm_data`：只有 `image_inputs is not None` 时才填 `'image'` 键，视频同理。`process_vision_info` 在没有任何图像元素时会返回 `None` 而非空列表（见 [qwen-vl-utils/src/qwen_vl_utils/vision_process.py:523-526](https://github.com/QwenLM/Qwen3-VL/blob/96588727e44c78b25ba03ea03b8e12f7e64fd0da/qwen-vl-utils/src/qwen_vl_utils/vision_process.py#L523-L526)），所以这个 `if` 判断既避免把 `None` 塞给 vLLM，也避免无意义的空键。

[README.md:1008-1018](https://github.com/QwenLM/Qwen3-VL/blob/96588727e44c78b25ba03ea03b8e12f7e64fd0da/README.md#L1008-L1018) —— README 离线示例中的同一段逻辑与最终返回的三件套字典：`mm_data` 的组装方式与 web 演示完全一致，最后返回 `{'prompt', 'multi_modal_data', 'mm_processor_kwargs'}` 三键字典，这就是单条 vLLM 请求的标准形态。

值得对比的是 [README.md:428-436](https://github.com/QwenLM/Qwen3-VL/blob/96588727e44c78b25ba03ea03b8e12f7e64fd0da/README.md#L428-L436)：README 在介绍 `qwen-vl-utils` 用法时给出了 Qwen3-VL 系列的标准调用姿势——`process_vision_info(messages, image_patch_size=16, return_video_kwargs=True, return_video_metadata=True)`，并提醒由于 utils 已经完成了缩放，transformers 手动调用 processor 时要传 `do_resize=False` 避免二次缩放。这条提醒针对的是 transformers 路径；vLLM 路径则通过 4.3 节的 `mm_processor_kwargs` 来传达同类信息。
